arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
cases = {
  "huge int literal": b'{"version": ' + b'1'*5000 + b'}',
  "huge int in packet": (b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[{"time":' + b'9'*5000 + b'}]}'),
  "deep nesting": b'[' * 100000 + b']' * 100000,
  "deep nesting 2": b'{"version":1,"config":' + b'[' * 50000 + b']' * 50000 + b'}',
  "long string": b'{"version":1,"config":{"slots":"' + b'a'*1000000 + b'"},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}',
  "many numbers array": b'{"version":1,"config":{"slots":[1,2,3]},' + b'"x":[' + b','.join([b'1']*100000) + b']}',
  "null everywhere": b'{"version":null,"config":null,"model":null,"connections":null,"packets":null}',
  "empty objects": b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}',
  "bom": b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":1}',
  "unicode escape id": b'{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[{"id":"\\u00e9","slot":0,"label":0,"split":"dev"}],"packets":[]}',
  "valid unicode key": '{"version":1,"config":{},"model":{},"connections":[],"packets":[]}'.encode(),
}
for name, data in cases.items():
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = p.stdout
    try:
        got = json.loads(out)
    except Exception:
        got = "NOT-JSON: " + repr(out[:100])
    print("%-22s rc=%d -> %s" % (name, p.returncode, json.dumps(got)[:80] if not isinstance(got,str) else got))
    if p.stderr:
        print("   stderr:", p.stderr[:200])
EOF
